common.title: Joint Threat Response
common.line: States hit by the same class of incident pool attribution, intelligence and response: a joint cyber command with real-time telemetry sharing that the Union is invited into, or a biosurveillance pact with binding sample-sharing and a standing investigation mandate.

notable.title: Catastrophic Biological Incident
notable.line: A global biological outbreak caused by a pathogen designed with AI.

notable.title: Hot Conflict Between Major Powers
notable.line: The US and China are shooting at each other.

notable.title: Recursive Self-Improvement Begins
notable.line: Frontier AI training can now be done basically without human intervention, and the pace stops being bottlenecked by human researchers.
